name: Takanashi Chidori
source:
She is the chairperson of the class committee. She is a hard-headed, inflexible, and serious person who cannot tolerate anything that is crooked or weak. She has a firm tone of voice and a seamless warrior-like demeanor, but she loves cute things and is very fond of Nanako.
